Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Zimra. A small blue world where everything moved in rhythm.

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The rivers kept time, the wind carried melodies, and every Zimran learned to read music before they could read words.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Another perfect evening. Even the stars sound in tune tonight.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: ...Huh? What are those lines in the sky?

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Five bright lines stretched across the horizon. Then, one by one, notes began to appear on them.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: It looks like a stave. Is someone writing music across the sky?

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: Then the music played, and they came.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Everyone, get to the ships! Go, go, go!

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: They struck exactly where the notes had pointed. Every blow landed on the beat.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: It's like they knew exactly where we'd be...

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: The Zimrans fled in every direction. Families, friends, whole towns, scattered across the stars.

Lines.Speaker: Tehilo
Lines.Text: Hello? Is anyone on this channel? Anyone from Zimra?

Lines.Speaker: Narrator
Lines.Text: No one answered. With his ship failing, Tehilo set a course for the nearest sign of life he could find.
